newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The private sector is expected to play a large role in Saudi Arabia's sixth five-year development plan, a study said.
- Saudi foreign affairs ministry said steps are being taken to facilitate the entry of foreign businessmen into the kingdom.
- The Saudi water and agriculture ministry is to construct 458 water projects worth 156 million riyals in different areas over three years.
